text:
ashley (partnerships): Quick sync: we need a compact onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure so new listings can go live without back-and-forth. Focus areas: procurement webhook shape, trial entitlement lifecycle, private-offer acceptance, and KMS/credentials. Who can own the checklist?
deepa (cloud-ops): I can own the creds/KMS section. For AWS private offers we do cross-account role + external-id. For Azure we'll need a service principal and role assignment scoped to resource group. GCP requires a service account with the Marketplace SaaS bindings. I'll draft minimal templates.
omar (product): Packaging decision: prefer one listing with multiple plans (trial, standard, reserved) and plan-level SKUs. Product needs entitlement payload to include plan_id, feature_flags, and region. Suggested entitlement format: redwood|offer:{offer_id}|plan:{plan_id}|r:{region}.
maria (legal): Legal needs two things: (1) telemetry opt-in language for EU customers and (2) a short addendum for private offers that clarifies reseller/responsible party for billing data. Also confirm retention windows for aggregated telemetry — default 90 days unless customer requests longer.
trent (solutions): From SI perspective, resellers often want a one-click provisioning callback. Can we include optional callback_url in the entitlement webhook so partners receive a conversion event? That would simplify the SI handoff.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: staging project and pubsub topics created for marketplace-integ-staging.
deepa (cloud-ops): I'll add terraform snippets for each cloud to the repo: AWS role + KMS policy, GCP service account + IAM bindings, Azure SP + role assignment. Also will add a short runbook for rotating integration keys.
omar (product): I'll publish the entitlement schema and a sample POST payload for fulfillment adapters: {"offer_id":"...","customer_id":"...","entitlement":"...","plan":"...","start_ts":"...","expires_ts":"..."}. We'll require HMAC verification on the webhook.
maria (legal): :thumbsup: Make sure we include data processing addendum language for customers in regulated sectors. I'll produce a redline by Friday.
trent (solutions): I'll prototype a small CLI for resellers to mint a provisional provisioning token that auto-expires; ops can promote to long-lived after verification.
ashley (partnerships): Owners: deepa -> infra templates + runbook; omar -> entitlement schema + sample payloads; maria -> legal addenda + telemetry wording; trent -> reseller CLI spec. Weekly checkpoint Thursday 9am PT. Any blockers?
deepa (cloud-ops): Blocking: need a billing account mapping for GCP and confirmation whether Azure private plans include a partner billing identifier. Can partnerships follow up with cloud contacts?
maria (legal): I'll reach out to Azure rep for clarity and report back.
omar (product): Also need to decide default trial TTL (14 days?) and whether auto-convert is allowed. Product prefers 14 days, manual convert by default.
trent (solutions): Fine with 14 days. We'll document a recommended customer UX for extension requests.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: scheduled smoke tests for onboarding flow tomorrow 02:00 PT. Results will post to #ci-results.
